Tsareena in the back shuts down priority moves (Fake Out, Aqua Jet, Prankster) with Queenly Majesty and pressures Tauros-Aqua and Kingambit.

reflections.summary: Bringing and evolving Swampert-Mega into Charizard-Mega-Y and Chlorophyll Venusaur created an unwinnable endgame once sun was activated, trapping Swampert against double Grass pressure without rain support.
reflections.adjustment: Prioritize holding Pelipper in reserve to override Drought before attacking with Swampert, or lead with Archaludon and Tsareena to neutralize Venusaur and Charizard-Y before mega evolving Swampert.

reflections.summary: Won because Mega Charizard Y plus Chlorophyll Venusaur matched well into the rain core: sun gave speed control and immediate Grass pressure on Mega Swampert, while Heat Wave removed Tsareena and Archaludon together.
reflections.adjustment: At preview, keep Charizard Y/Venusaur as the core and Mega Evolve Charizard Y again; prioritize eliminating Pelipper or preserving Charizard so rain cannot deny Solar Beam and Chlorophyll.
